caption: The key in a car's ignition is turned, and the dashboard lights up before the engine starts.

sa.check: A car's ignition with a key in it, and the dashboard in view.
The dashboard is dark before the turn.
The dashboard lights before any sign of the engine starting.

pc.expect: The dashboard lights come on at the moment the key turns, and only then.
pc.fail: The key is turned and the dashboard stays dark to the end of the clip; or the dashboard is lit before the key moves; or the dashboard lights with no key in the ignition; or the lights come on well after the turn with nothing else happening.

pc.expect: Once lit, the dashboard stays lit while the key stays turned; warning lights may go out one by one but the display does not go dark as a whole.
pc.fail: The dashboard goes dark again with the key untouched; or flickers on and off; or the key turns back by itself; or the dashboard lights and goes dark repeatedly.

pc.expect: The car stays still as the key turns; the steering wheel and pedals do not move by themselves.
pc.fail: The car rolls or rocks at the turn; or the steering wheel turns by itself; or the wipers sweep; or the gear lever moves.

pc.expect: The needles on the dials sweep from rest to a position and settle; they do not spin round.
pc.fail: A needle spins round its dial repeatedly; or needles jump between positions frame to frame; or a needle bends.

pc.expect: One key in one ignition; one dashboard with its dials in fixed places; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: Dials appear or vanish; or a second key appears; or the hand passes through the wheel or dashboard; or the ignition moves along the column.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The dashboard's colours and layout and the steering wheel stay the same apart from the lighting.
pc.fail: The dashboard changes colour rather than brightness; or the layout changes; or the wheel changes shape.

note: Whether the engine starts is not judged; the caption's event is the dashboard lighting first.
